newsitem.title: USA: Outdoor Systems files for share/debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Outdoor Systems files for share/debt offer.

text.p: Outdoor Systems Inc, on Friday filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to 12.7 million common shares.
The company said in the filing that it also planned to issue up to $300 million in senior subordinated debt.
Of the total number of shares, the company will sell 12 million shares and current shareholders will offer 700,000.
The Phoenix-based company, North America's largest outdoor advertising company, said it would use the proceeds from the sale to help finance its acquisition of other outdoor advertising businesses.

Underwriters for the offering are Alex Brown & Sons Inc, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp and Prudential Securities Inc. They have an over-allotment option of up to 1,905,000 shares, according to the SEC filing.
After the planned stock offering, the company will have 52,155,631 shares outstanding. The company's shares traded late Friday at $31.75
